# Castle Garage Doors & Gates
> Veteran-owned, family-operated garage door and gate service company serving San Diego County to Riverside County since 1981. Authorized Home Depot Service Provider and Clopay Authorized Dealer.

## Primary services
- Garage door repair (springs, cables, rollers, panels, tracks, sensors)
- New garage door installation (Clopay)
- Garage door opener installation and repair (LiftMaster, Marantec, Genie)
- Automatic gate installation and repair
- 24/7 emergency service

## Service area
San Diego, Escondido, Oceanside, Carlsbad, Encinitas, North County San Diego, Temecula, Murrieta, Fallbrook, Bonsall, Riverside County, Corona
